content:
IQSS has undergone difficult changes resulting from Harvard’s internal FAS Workforce Planning effort. However, our IQSS services, capabilities, and service quality remain unaffected.

Our research infrastructure, including the Dataverse platform that underpins data sharing across Harvard and the world, is central to our mission and remains fully supported.

https://www.iq.harvard.edu/news/2026/08/scale-iqss-numbers

Regards
Sonia Barbosa
Associate Director
Dataverse Support, Data Curation, and the Murray Archive
